scope.unit: Complete player-facing feature bundles. No extra points for their files, assets, internal phases, tiers or tests.
scope.gate_rule: One gate for an accepted complete reference contract, one for implementation verified against it.

excluded.name: Real-money payments and external platform login providers
excluded.reason: Historical gameplay reconstruction; no monetization or live third-party identity service recreation proposed.

excluded.name: Editor-world/debug entry, test records and scrapped Dreamscape
excluded.reason: Retained in the raw audit, not established as target production gameplay. Review separately; do not silently add custom content.

excluded.name: Post-target classes, pet feeding/fusion, Gift Chest, Candyland and later boosters

scope.unresolved: Feature boundaries and production-only/helper dispositions remain reviewable. This draft is an explicit proposed scope, not a certified exhaustive denominator.

candidate_features.name: Character news and death history
candidate_features.reason: Visible in period footage and present in selected original CharsAndNews/News bytecode; retention, ordering and service boundaries need review.

features.name: Choose and unlock classes
features.criterion: The original chooser, starting records and persistent class-unlock prerequisites.

evidence.reference: Selected class XML, original chooser/CREATE bytecode and researched unlock records. Existing ready-to-implement issues #1 and #2. The existing accepted chooser reference is retained. PRs #38, #42 and #46 extend persisted unlock prerequisites and class creation to all thirteen classes. Prepared ability demonstrations do not establish every ordinary unlock journey, so no recreation gate is added.

features.name: Level to 20
features.criterion: XP awards and sharing, level thresholds, stat gains and level caps.

evidence.reference: Merged PR #19 already implements random, per-class stat gains from selected XML minimum/maximum growth fields, with caps. Native leveling and level-boundary tests through 20 passed; this is existing work, not a new addition. Complete historical XP awards, sharing and growth rules remain unaccepted. PR #35 adds inland progression and permanent-stat consumption. XP sharing, reward rates and complete historical progression remain candidate policies.

features.name: Living fame
features.criterion: Fame earned while alive and the displayed progress toward the next class quest.

evidence.reference: PR #35 records earned base fame as XP/1000 and retains it with committed progression and death. This is a reference-server candidate policy; complete original fame scoring and death bonuses are not restored.

requirements: The XP-to-fame HUD transition at level 20.
Living fame gains and progress toward class quests.

features.name: Fame bonuses
features.criterion: Death bonuses, eligibility, rounding and account fame awards.

features.name: Class stars
features.criterion: Class fame quests, unlock records and account star totals.

features.name: Legends highscores
features.criterion: Leaderboard periods, ranking, character details and ties.

evidence.reference: Merged PR #21 verifies native Week/Month/All Time rows, detail navigation, immutable deaths and deterministic ties, including three genuinely dead named players. Historical period, eligibility and ranking policies remain reference-server candidates, not an accepted full target contract.

features.name: Recover HP and MP
features.criterion: Vitality, Wisdom, caps and condition interactions.

evidence.reference: Shared regeneration, Quiet/Sick interactions and class healing effects are implemented. Prepared native ability tests cover several healing paths; the full historical recovery contract remains unverified.

features.name: Death and restart
features.criterion: Permanent death without a resurrection amulet, saved death records, Continue and replacement character creation.

evidence.reference: Original DEATH packet, native death/fame/Continue flow and selected-client character replacement behavior. Fame-award formulas and resurrection are separate features.
evidence.verification: Independent fresh-clone native acceptance: ordinary death, Continue, Legends, Done, Play, replacement Wizard, movement and spell. No reload workaround.

features.name: Gravestones
features.criterion: Grave tiers, placement, labels, contents and expiry.

features.name: Realm generation
features.criterion: Coast, lowlands, midlands, highlands and mountains with target terrain, roads and population placement.

evidence.reference: Seeded candidate terrain now carries inland populations, grouped Elves, shore/lowland families and bounded Godlands encounters. Roads, placement, density and replacement policies are reconstructions, not recovered original generation.

features.name: Find your next quest
features.criterion: Level-appropriate targets, quest arrows and enemy discovery.

evidence.reference: Level-filtered quest targets, distant native markers, replacement targets and quest credit are implemented. Native Elf and lowland encounters exercise these paths; complete original selection and credit policies remain unverified.

requirements: Level-appropriate targets, quest arrows and enemy discovery.
Quest completion feedback, replacement targets and credit rules.

features.name: Realm closure
features.criterion: Encounter population, Oryx announcements, closing and the castle transfer.

evidence.reference: A candidate closure cycle uses six finite original Red Demon/Cyclops identities, announcements, countdown, admission sealing, collective Castle transfer and a replacement Realm. Prepared collective transfer is not a freshly earned full Realm clear or accepted historical population policy.

features.name: Walk and dodge
features.criterion: Speed, normalized input, walls, corners, slowing, sinking and movement validation.

evidence.reference: PR #35 adds shared conditions and terrain movement; PR #36 changes native movement/cadence authority to preserve the unchanged client through network jitter while retaining bounded ingress. This is candidate responsiveness work, not complete historical movement or load acceptance.

features.name: Shoot and take damage
features.criterion: Weapon cadence and trajectories, hit selection, defense, conditions and damage acknowledgements.

evidence.reference: Native cadence, mirrored projectiles and once-only acknowledged contact handling coexist with shared simulated combat. Class abilities and Godlands effects extend combat coverage. Complete historical combat rules and representative load remain unverified.

features.name: Environmental hazards
features.criterion: Lava, pools, sinking, pushing, collision and protective equipment.

evidence.reference: Selected dungeon conveyors, traps, delayed grenades and encounter fields are implemented. Complete target lava, pools, sinking and protective-equipment interactions are not established.

features.name: Travel between worlds
features.criterion: Nexus escape and authorized portal/reconnect transfers of the same living character.

evidence.reference: Original USEPORTAL, ESCAPE, RECONNECT and LOAD bytecode; endpoint inheritance and active-character semantics. Complete researched transfer contract on issue #11.
evidence.verification: Merged PR #19: two native Wizards used a genuinely dropped portal to enter the same Pirate Cave, then the published boss exit to return to Nexus with the same character through LOAD. Tests verify account/character-bound, expiring, single-use transfer grants and durable departure before entry.
